- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The evolution of language has significantly influenced how writers use prose, adapting to audience needs and expectations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Earlier language was more formal and structured, leading to ornate and complex prose, while modern language is more informal, concise, and direct.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Modern writers strive for clarity and simplicity, using shorter sentences and avoiding complex structures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dialogue has become an essential component of modern writing due to the influence of social media and digital communication.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Technology has significantly impacted language, making communication more immediate, informal, and reliant on visual content.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Social media has led to new vocabulary and forms of expression, including hashtags, acronyms, and slang.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Technological advancements have facilitated the emergence of new language variants, such as Spanglish or Hinglish.
- [USER] User expressed fascination with the evolution of language and technology together.
